family_reports.body: The family court system has singlehandedly destroyed my family. We have been separated for years and only see them a few times a year. It will probably cause my younger kids to go through therapy at some point.

public_comments.comment_text: Completely sided with my husband and bullied me relentlessly. It was torturous. He would brag about his kids the whole time. “If I can get along with my ex, I don’t see why you can’t,” was his basic principle. He became very impatient if I would not agree to things on the spot under pressure from him and my ex husband. A horrible person. WAY overpriced!
